hook: The downloaded corpus has to land in a layout the trainer can stream from at line speed. JSONL on disk does not survive 16 dataloader workers. HDF5 with a resizable, chunked integer dataset does. This lesson builds streaming tokenization into a resizable HDF5 dataset, sharded write across multiple files, memory-mapped read at training time, and a sliding-window dataloader that produces fixed-length sequences with the right packing.
